title: skimmia oblata var. variegata
intro: Skimmia oblata var. variegata, commonly known as the Variegated Japanese Skimmia, is a plant species native to East Asia and is a member of the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Skimmia oblata var. variegata include acting as a nervine tonic, sedative, and antispasmodic, which can help in calming the nervous system and relieving muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
